title: OAuth refresh token lost during token refresh, causing 'No refresh token is set' after ~1 hour

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue report provides a clear, actionable bug description detailing the root cause, steps to reproduce, expected behavior, and environment details for both OAuth refresh token loss and credential deletion errors.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The fix involves straightforward changes in two files within packages/core: merging existing refresh tokens during token cache updates in oauth2.ts and making deleteCredentials non-throwing for missing keys in keychain-token-storage.ts.

summary.problem: OAuth refresh token is lost during token refreshes, causing session failure after ~1 hour, and deleteCredentials throws errors when trying to clear already-deleted credentials.
summary.root_cause: The tokens event during OAuth token refresh provides a new access_token without resending refresh_token. cacheCredentials in oauth2.ts overwrites stored credentials without merging existing refresh tokens. Furthermore, KeychainTokenStorage.deleteCredentials throws when credentials are not found, creating a cascading error loop during re-authentication.
summary.context: Occurs when using OAuth authentication after initial access token expiration (~1 hour), affecting both file-based and encrypted token storage paths.

steps: In packages/core/src/code_assist/oauth2.ts, update cacheCredentials to read existing credentials from disk if present and merge existing refresh_token when the new token payload lacks a refresh_token.
In packages/core/src/mcp/token-storage/keychain-token-storage.ts, modify deleteCredentials so that deleting a non-existent server account succeeds silently without throwing an error.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: Cache updates during access token refresh preserve the stored refresh_token, and deleteCredentials on non-existent credentials completes cleanly without throwing.
verification_steps: Add unit tests in oauth2.test.ts testing cacheCredentials when updating tokens without a refresh_token to ensure existing refresh_token is retained.
Add unit tests in keychain-token-storage.test.ts verifying that calling deleteCredentials on a non-existent account does not throw an error.
